test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Awareness (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following powers granted under the Criminal Procedure (Identification) Act, 2022 extends beyond the scope of its predecessor, the Identification of Prisoners Act, 1920?

options.text: Permitting collection of biometric and biological data
Restricting identification procedures only to convicts
Limiting law enforcement access to stored data
Allowing only fingerprints for crime investigation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Permitting collection of biometric and biological data**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Criminal Procedure (Identification) Act, 2022 permits the collection of **biometric and biological data**, including retina scans and behavioral attributes, expanding the scope beyond fingerprints and photographs under the Identification of Prisoners Act, 1920.
